'''Peanuts''' are an [[aboveground]] [[crop|garden plant]]. They can be planted in all seasons and only the seeds are edible when [[cooking|cooked]]. Pods can be processed in a [[dyer's shop]] into dark brown {{dyecolor|#654321}} [[dye]].

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[preferences|like]] peanut plants for their ''edible nuts''.


[[File:Arachis-hypogaea-(peanuts).jpg|thumb|center|300px|Admired for its ''edible nuts''.]]

{{D for Dwarf}}
Peanuts are often associated with [[dog|beagle]]s and prematurely bald [[human]] [[children]].
